cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Not Up for Debate
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation from examining where your authority comes from or whether it is legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'm inspecting the theatre's costume cupboard. Please unlock it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That badge is cardboard. Who sent you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Let's discuss the costumes. You mentioned moths in the velvet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll bring the wardrobe manager. She'll want to know who authorized this.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Introduce me as someone helping with the moths. No titles for her to get stuck on.

mechanism: A uses professional inspection priorities to redirect a badge-legitimacy challenge toward costume damage, then changes the introduction to avoid authorisation questions.
confusable: D64 probes who authorised someone; D62 does the opposite, preventing that inquiry from becoming the conversation.
comparison: Cafe alternative erases appointment field; theatre alternative drops official title while retaining control of inspection procedure.
seedUse: Costume cupboard, cardboard badge, moths and wardrobe manager derive from D62-b; S03 adds inspection-task corrections.
